title: Fire Department Educational Request
description: Use this service request to request fire safety educational programs only. Requests to visit a fire station or to have an engine on location must be submitted to the following email address: dfrshowandtell@dallasfire.gov. The estimated response time for this service request is 2 business days.

observedQuestions.question: What kind of program or training are you requesting?
What is the occupancy location type?
What age group is the audience?
What is the preferred date and time for the program?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a Dallas Fire-Rescue safety education program.
actions.why: To request a fire-safety educational program or training, such as a fire safety house, fire brigade training, high-rise or home fire safety, programs for hospitals, nursing homes, hotels or schools, safety fairs, senior talks, Sparky, or extinguisher training. The 311 request form asks for the program type and can collect occupancy type, audience age group, and preferred date and time.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Fire Department Educational Request" requests does not apply to a fire-station visit or having a fire engine at a location. If you want a station visit or an engine on location, then email Dallas Fire-Rescue at dfrshowandtell@dallasfire.gov.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Fire Department Educational Request"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Fire Department Educational Request"

actions.tagline: Email Dallas Fire-Rescue to request a fire-station visit or engine at a location.
actions.why: For a request to visit a fire station or have a fire engine on location; the service description directs these requests to Dallas Fire-Rescue by email.
